goal: load_policy parses an optional [store] section (backend = "sqlite"|"postgres", optional schema string) into WorkPolicy fields store_backend and store_schema, defaulting to sqlite when the section is absent.

schema, when present, must be a non-empty string; reject other types with PolicyError
Do not change the init template or _cmd_init in this task; that lands in init-interactive-flow
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (feat:) before emitting intent=verify

No changes to _workflow.py or any CLI verb
edge_cases: [store] present but empty table -> sqlite defaults, no error
backend = "postgres" with no schema key -> store_schema stays None
